commands.label: /continue
commands.description: Continue the active scene with continuity-aware context
commands.why_use: Continue the active scene without restating continuity, cast, POV, and open threads manually.

commands.label: /rewrite
commands.description: Rewrite current/selected material while preserving requested constraints
commands.why_use: Revise prose while keeping current authoritative state and continuity visible to the writer.

commands.label: /mono
commands.why_use: Realize one character's expression through their voice, state, relationships, and POV boundaries.
examples: /mono @Fila internal slow "why did I say that?"

commands.label: /dia
commands.why_use: Use a relationship-aware dialogue profile instead of merely asking the model to write dialogue.

commands.label: /ambience
commands.description: Guide atmosphere and sensory emphasis without changing canon
commands.why_use: Steer atmosphere and sensory density without silently creating persistent location facts.

commands.label: /intimacy
commands.description: Guide character-aware intimate scene dynamics and aftermath
commands.why_use: Use the same continuity, agency, POV, relationship, pacing, and aftermath rails as other character interaction.

commands.label: /intuition
commands.description: Ask the narrative deliberator what most naturally follows from the current state
commands.why_use: Ask what most naturally follows before committing to prose. Output remains non-canonical author-facing reasoning.

commands.label: /alternatives
commands.why_use: Generate bounded non-canonical alternatives without silently choosing one.

commands.label: /describe
commands.description: Describe a referenced subject with selector-aware context
commands.why_use: Description becomes selector-aware, so @Fila.appearance and @Fila.state can request different evidence.

commands.label: /pov
commands.description: Temporarily emphasize a POV reference for this generation
commands.why_use: Temporarily set the epistemic anchor for one request without mutating the active scene.

commands.label: /pace
commands.description: Temporarily steer narrative pacing for this generation
commands.why_use: Apply pacing as structured request metadata rather than repeating prose instructions.
